article.story: MURRAY, Ky. -- — Brayden Shorter had 21 points and Brigham Rogers posted a double-double in Murray State’s 99-78 victory over Texas Southern on Friday night. Shorter shot 7 for 12 from beyond the arc for the Racers (4-0). Rogers totaled 16 points and 10 rebounds. Roman Domon added 14 points, eight rebounds and five assists. Karris Bilal led the way for the Tigers (1-3) with 30 points and three steals. Bencao Vungo added 16 points, eight rebounds and two blocks. Trey Lewis finished with 10 points. Murray State took the lead with 4:56 left in the first half and did not trail again. Shorter led with 21 points in the first half to help put them up 50-38 at the break. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
